text:
GENERATE BURST KW3D-E-fit — (the Grok-fitted motion) Run C-9 P7, the 3D-body knight: PAINT-OVER of one walk cycle on one sheet (Matt R-C9-59). task_id "KW3D-E-fit".

IMAGE 1 is a SPRITE SHEET: 12 animation frames of ONE walk cycle of a knight walking to the viewer's RIGHT (east), in reading order (left to right, top to bottom), each frame centred in its own cell of a 4x3 grid, on flat pure #00ff00. The frames are rough renders from a 3D model: their POSES, OUTLINES, POSITIONS and SIZES are correct, but their painting is poor (blotchy, patchy heraldry, a blocky mail skirt).
IMAGE 2 is the approved painting of this same knight facing the same way: his exact helm and visor, gorget, plate armour, blue tabard with its gold crosses and diagonal gold-and-blue bands and red lining, his pollaxe, and the painter's hand (dark ink line, hatching, transparent washes). IMAGE 3 is the same knight with the tabard removed, showing the armour under it (the waist lames and the mail skirt), for the parts the tabard reveals as the legs move.
Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 1 and deliver ONE 1536x1024 sheet in which EVERY one of the 12 figures is repainted as the knight of IMAGE 2, in EXACTLY that frame's pose, outline, position and size: same place in its cell, same leg and arm angles, same pollaxe line, feet on the same spot. Paint all 12 in ONE consistent hand, so that the armour, the tabard heraldry, the helm and the colours are IDENTICAL from frame to frame (this is an animation: any change between frames will flicker). Where the tabard parts, show the mail skirt of IMAGE 3. Keep the pollaxe blade facing forward as in IMAGE 1.
Keep the background flat pure #00ff00, the grid of 12 frames exactly as laid out, no frame added, removed, merged or reordered, no cell borders, no text, no shadows on the ground.
STYLE: the REGISTER CARD above is satisfied BY IMAGE 2: copy its hand; do not restyle.

Two image_gen EDIT calls: variants a and b. ONE retry per variant only if a frame's pose or position changed, a frame is missing or duplicated, the knight differs between frames, or the background is not flat green — name the reason. Copy outputs to out/KW3D-E-fit_a.png and out/KW3D-E-fit_b.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "KW3D-E-fit"; images = the files with prompt, references (role + path) and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — the sprite sheet to EDIT (12 walk frames; poses and outlines correct, paint poor)
IMAGE 2 — the approved painting of this knight facing east (look, armour, heraldry, hand)
IMAGE 3 — the same knight with the tabard removed (the armour and mail skirt under it)
